D: A bullied boy in 1980s Stockholm befriends a mysterious girl who turns out to be a vampire.
P: Serve the snacks when Oskar and Eli work on the puzzle cube.
S: Beef and pork mince with soaked breadcrumbs, grated onion, allspice and egg, rolled small, browned in butter, finished in a cream and beef stock sauce. Lingonberry jam.
Cubes of three cheeses (gouda, Swedish hard cheese, cheddar) and cucumber stacked into a coloured cube on a board.
Oskar's after-school snack alone at the kitchen table

Rye crispbread spread with cold salted butter, shaved aged hard cheese and cucumber sliced paper thin, a grind of white pepper and a few dill fronds on top. Build just before serving so it stays crisp.
M: Oskar's mum's weeknight dinner in the flat

Meatballs browned in butter, simmered 10 minutes in beef stock and cream thickened with a little flour, served over mash beaten with hot milk and butter, quick-pickled cucumber and a spoon of lingonberry jam.
prawns, dill and mayo on buttered toast
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with mayo, crème fraîche, dill, lemon and a little horseradish, piled on butter-fried bread, roe on top.
W: Cardamom-scented yeasted dough rolled with butter, sugar and cinnamon, cut, knotted, proved, baked at 220C for 10 minutes, pearl sugar on top.
K: Blackcurrant cordial topped with hot water and a squeeze of lemon.

s.how: Soak 50g breadcrumbs in milk, then mix with 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, half a tsp allspice and 1 egg. Roll small and brown in butter. Simmer in 200ml stock and 150ml cream for 10 minutes. Serve with lingonberry jam.

s.note: Oskar's after-school snack alone at the kitchen table
s.how: Spread 12 rye crispbreads with cold salted butter. Top with shaved aged hard cheese, about 150g, and cucumber sliced paper thin. Finish with white pepper and dill. Build them just before serving so they stay crisp.

m.note: prawns, dill and mayo on buttered toast
m.how: Chop 500g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, 3 tbsp crème fraîche, chopped dill, lemon juice and 1 tsp horseradish. Fry 4 slices white bread in 40g butter until golden. Pile the prawns on top and add a little roe if you have it.

w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 75g sugar, 300ml warm milk and 75g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 100g butter, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cinnamon. Cut strips, knot and prove 30 minutes. Brush with egg, add pearl sugar and bake at 220C for 10 minutes.

d.how: Pour 50ml blackcurrant cordial into each of four mugs. Top with hot water from the kettle and add a squeeze of lemon. Wrap your hands around it on a snowy night.
